title: Preparing Data for Models
description: Most ML work is data work: cleaning, encoding, and splitting before any model is trained.
learningOutcomes: Encode categorical and numeric features correctly
Handle missing data without leaking information
Build a repeatable data preparation step

lessons.title: Numeric and Categorical Features
lessons.description: Why a model can't just eat a DataFrame of strings.
learningObjectives: Distinguish numeric, ordinal, and categorical features
Choose an encoding for each type

lessons.title: Scaling and Normalization
lessons.description: Why features on different scales confuse many models.
learningObjectives: Explain which models need scaling and which don't
Fit scalers on train data only

lessons.title: Handling Missing Data
lessons.description: Imputation strategies, and the leakage trap that ruins them.
learningObjectives: Choose an imputation strategy for a column
Explain data leakage from imputing before splitting
Flag missingness as a feature when it's informative

lessons.title: A Repeatable Preparation Pipeline
lessons.description: Wrap preparation steps so training and inference stay consistent.
learningObjectives: Build a scikit-learn Pipeline for preprocessing
